Game development notes

DevelopmentDecember 27, 2022
components.css: .ds-card{min-width:0;max-width:360px;font-family:system-ui;color:var(--text,#f3f0fa)}.ds-card>a{display:block;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.ds-cover{aspect-ratio:1;overflow:hidden;border-radius:4px;background:#847bd9;position:relative;isolation:isolate}.ds-cover:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-16%;filter:blur(36px);background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 90%,#3e69d5 0%,transparent 60%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 95% 10%,#e8b9e6 0%,transparent 65%),linear-gradient(120deg,#6766ce,#ac8bdd);transform:rotate(-12deg)}.ds-card h2{font:500 1.125rem/1.45 system-ui;margin:1rem 0 .75rem}.ds-card a:hover h2{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.2em}.ds-card a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--signal,#ffd75e);outline-offset:5px}.ds-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.25rem .75rem;color:var(--muted,#bdbbc9);font:.8125rem/1.6 system-ui}.ds-meta span{color:var(--text,#f3f0fa)}

narrative.overview: II Games uses a dark, artwork-led studio identity. Preserve the logo, self-hosted Nevis lettering, cyan primary actions, real game imagery, accurate credits, and informal small-team voice. All routes share the same neutral palette and navigation.
